player_prompt.intro:
Ngwe wena Mdlali {player_id} ku **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Ngikhomba khona lokusebenza kwakho njengenye **[macro  micro]** (tinombolo zimbili 0-8):
• *macro*  = kuphina ibhodi ndogo uyidlale kuyo
• *micro* = kuphina iskhwele ndani kwaleyo bhodi ndogo
Isibonelo `[7 8]` ➜ beka isikhala sakho kwenye bhodi ndogo 7, iskhwele 8, futhi
faka mphini wakho adlale kwenye bhodi ndogo 8 emuva kwako.

Ngwe wena `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Lokunyakata kufanele kube nguloku [macro micro] ngekuhlanganisa tinombolo 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Tonkhe tinkhomba kumele tibe semkhatsini wa 0 na 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Ibhodi lencane, umugca nobe likholomu alikho endzaweni yekusebenta.

next_board.any: nobe nguliphi libhodi lelibitwa ngekutsi yi-micro board

game_action.played: Mdlali {player_id} udle kwenye bhodi ndogo {macro_idx}, iskhwele {micro_idx} (umshwathi {row}, inkoliso {col}). Mdlali {opponent_id} ufanele adlale manje kwenye {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Umdlali {player_id} uncobile i-Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
